title.zh: OpenAI、Google和Meta在白宫自愿协议下承诺进行独立AI安全审计
title.en: OpenAI, Google and Meta pledge independent AI safety audits under voluntary White House deal

current_state.zh: OpenAI、Google、Meta、Anthropic、Nvidia和xAI签署了《前沿责任联合承诺》，同意对AI安全控制进行独立外部审计，涵盖网络攻击、黑客和生物/化学风险，但无处罚、披露规则或实施截止日期；白宫已公布协议全文。
current_state.en: OpenAI, Google, Meta, Anthropic, Nvidia and xAI signed the 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities,' agreeing to independent outside audits of AI safety controls covering cyberattack, hacking and biological/chemical risks, with no penalties, disclosure rules or implementation deadline; the White House has released the full text of the accord.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI、Google和Meta在白宫自愿协议下承诺进行独立AI安全审计
updates.title_en: OpenAI, Google and Meta pledge independent AI safety audits under voluntary White House deal
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI、Google、Meta、Anthropic、Nvidia和xAI同意在白宫一项涵盖网络攻击、黑客入侵及生物/化学风险的自愿协议下，对其AI安全控制措施进行独立外部审计，协议不设处罚、披露规则或实施期限。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI, Google, Meta, Anthropic, Nvidia and xAI agreed to independent outside audits of their AI safety controls under a voluntary White House pact covering cyberattack, hacking and biological/chemical risks, with no penalties, disclosure rules or implementation deadline.

updates.title_zh: 在特朗普的协议下，科技领袖将如何自我监管AI安全
updates.title_en: Here’s how tech leaders will self-police AI safety under Trump’s deal
updates.what_changed_zh: 白宫公布了该自愿协议的全部细节，正式名称为《前沿责任联合承诺》（Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities），由科技高管签署，属道义约束而非法律强制，并由总统顾问David Sacks在线分享。
updates.what_changed_en: The White House released full details of the voluntary accord, officially titled the 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities', signed by tech executives as a morally binding commitment and shared online by presidential adviser David Sacks.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI、Google、Meta、Anthropic、Nvidia和xAI签署了《前沿责任联合承诺》，同意对AI安全控制进行独立外部审计，涵盖网络攻击、黑客和生物/化学风险，但无处罚、披露规则或实施截止日期；白宫已公布协议全文。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI, Google, Meta, Anthropic, Nvidia and xAI signed the 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities,' agreeing to independent outside audits of AI safety controls covering cyberattack, hacking and biological/chemical risks, with no penalties, disclosure rules or implementation deadline; the White House has released the full text of the accord.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The White House released full details of its 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities,' a morally binding AI safety accord in which leading tech executives agreed to self-regulate frontier AI development under the Trump administration.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The White House released full details of its 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities,' a morally binding AI safety accord in which leading tech executives agreed to self-regulate frontier AI development under the Trump administration.
